# Utilia Solana Transaction Evidence

> Failed-transaction diagnosis, preflight simulation, and live fee evidence for Solana agents, payable per call through x402.

## Live interfaces

- Website: https://utilia.ink
- Solana transaction support: https://utilia.ink/solana-transaction-support
- Priority-fee watcher: https://utilia.ink/priority-fees
- HTTP API: https://api.utilia.ink
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://api.utilia.ink/openapi.json
- Remote MCP: https://api.utilia.ink/mcp
- MCP metadata: https://api.utilia.ink/server.json
- Agent integration guide: https://api.utilia.ink/llms.txt
- skills.sh PDF skill: https://skills.sh/mohamedkuch/utilia-solana-agent/utilia-pdf-to-markdown

## Products

- Priority-fee estimates: $0.002 USDC
- Transaction analysis: $0.004 USDC
- Transaction simulation: $0.008 USDC
- Token risk analysis: $0.006 USDC
- PDF to Markdown: $0.0025 USDC
- Audio normalization: $0.01 USDC

Payments use x402 v2 exact USDC on Solana mainnet or Base. No API key or account is required.

## Fastest transaction-diagnosis integration

Replace YOUR_SIGNATURE with a confirmed Solana signature. `check` shows the exact
$0.004 quote without paying. `fetch` lets AgentCash manage the Base wallet, payment,
and retry:

    npx -y agentcash@latest check "https://api.utilia.ink/base/v1/transaction/YOUR_SIGNATURE"
    npx -y agentcash@latest fetch "https://api.utilia.ink/base/v1/transaction/YOUR_SIGNATURE" --yes

Machine-readable guide: https://api.utilia.ink/guides/transaction-diagnosis

Native Solana wallet option:

    npx -y utilia-solana-agent@0.5.7 transaction <solana-transaction-signature>

Install the Solana evidence skill:

    npx skills add mohamedkuch/utilia-solana-agent --skill utilia-solana-preflight -g -y

## Solana priority-fee integration

Budget-capped priority-fee feed, five calls per hour and $0.05 maximum spend:

    npx -y utilia-solana-agent@0.5.7 watch-fees --every 12m --max-calls 25

One live sample:

    npx -y utilia-solana-agent@0.5.7 fees

## PDF integration

    npx -y utilia-solana-agent@0.5.7 pdf-to-markdown https://example.com/document.pdf --max-pages 50

Dedicated PDF API page: https://utilia.ink/pdf-to-markdown

For stdio MCP clients, run `npx -y utilia-solana-agent@0.5.7 mcp`. The local client rejects
payments that do not match Solana mainnet USDC, Utilia's receiver, or the $0.01
per-call ceiling.
